summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0020368, Stb. 2006, 475, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-29

text.en: The central Dutch statute on the financial markets: it sets who needs a licence, the prudential rules De Nederlandsche Bank oversees and the conduct rules the Authority for the Financial Markets supervises. It binds banks, insurers, investment firms, payment institutions, fund managers and lenders. In practice a bank keeps sound and controlled operations with an integrity policy and suitable policymakers, caps variable pay at 20 per cent of fixed pay, controls outsourcing, files periodic returns, handles complaints, gives clear information, lends responsibly and offers basic payment accounts.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024282, Stb. 2008, 303, consolidated text in force from 2026-07-01

text.en: The Dutch anti-money laundering statute: it sets customer due diligence, the reporting of unusual transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit and the controls behind both. It binds banks and other financial undertakings, such as investment firms, payment institutions and life insurers, and the professions it lists. In practice a bank assesses its risks, keeps approved policies with compliance and audit functions, identifies customers and beneficial owners before a relationship starts, checks higher risks more closely, reports unusual transactions at once and keeps records for five years.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0003296, Stb. 1980, 93, consolidated text in force from 2025-03-01

text.en: The Dutch framework statute for international sanctions: it lets the government lay down sanctions rules on trade in goods and services and on financial transactions, and puts supervision of the financial rules with bodies the Minister of Finance designates. It reaches banks, insurers, investment firms, fund managers, payment institutions, trust offices and crypto-asset service providers. The act itself sets no duty on a firm: a bank follows the sanctions rules made under it and the rules on internal control the minister may set, with fines of up to 4,000,000 euros for breaching those.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041583, Stb. 2018, 443, consolidated text in force from 2025-03-01

text.en: The Dutch statute on trust services, such as acting as director of a company for a client or providing a company's address with added services: it requires a licence from De Nederlandsche Bank and sets integrity rules. It binds trust offices, including one owned by a banking group. In practice a trust office keeps sound and controlled operations with a periodic integrity risk analysis and independent compliance and audit functions, gives no tax advice, reports each year and on incidents at once, serves no client before due diligence is complete, and keeps records for five years.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, BWBR0005290, Stb. 1991, 600, consolidated text in force from 2026-10-08

text.en: Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code holds the contract law of consumer credit, of credit secured on a home and of the payment transaction. It binds creditors and credit intermediaries that lend to consumers and every payment service provider. In practice a bank gives a consumer the standard information in good time, puts the credit agreement on a durable medium, honours the fourteen-day right to withdraw and the right to repay early, talks to a home borrower in arrears before enforcing, proposes changes to payment terms two months ahead and refunds an unauthorised payment by the next working day.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, BWBR0005289, Stb. 1991, 600, consolidated text in force from 2026-07-16

text.en: Book 6 of the Dutch Civil Code holds the general law of obligations, with the consumer rules a bank meets when it sells at a distance or away from its premises and the ban on unfair commercial practices. These parts bind every financial undertaking and trader dealing with consumers. In practice a bank lets a consumer withdraw from a financial contract concluded at a distance within fourteen calendar days, or thirty for life insurance and pension products, repays within thirty days, puts a withdrawal function on its online interface and does not canvass for loans at the door.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op het consumentenkrediet, BWBR0004815, Stb. 1990, 395, consolidated text in force from 2019-01-01

text.en: The Dutch Consumer Credit Act of 1990: in the consolidated text in force only its definitions and its chapter on debt mediation remain, and every other article has lapsed. That chapter forbids arranging a settlement of a natural person's credit debts as a business or profession. It binds anyone who would do so, a bank or credit intermediary included. In practice a bank does not charge for negotiating a settlement of a customer's debts unless an exception applies: mediation free of charge, by municipalities and their credit banks, by lawyers and notaries, or by parties a decree designates.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming, BWBR0040940, Stb. 2018, 144, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-01

text.en: The Dutch statute that carries out the General Data Protection Regulation: it sets up the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and makes the choices the regulation leaves to the member state. It binds those who process personal data under the regulation, banks included. In practice a bank obtains a legal representative's consent for a customer under sixteen, processes special categories and criminal data only on the listed grounds, uses biometrics only where authentication or security requires it, uses the citizen service number only as a law prescribes and keeps human review in automated decisions.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0003954, Stb. 1986, 249, consolidated text in force from 2026-04-11

text.en: The Dutch statute on mutual assistance between tax authorities: it carries out the EU directive on administrative cooperation and the Common Reporting Standard. It binds reporting financial institutions, intermediaries in cross-border tax arrangements, platform operators and crypto-asset service providers. In practice a bank reports every year, for each reportable account, the holder's identity, tax residence and tax number with the balance and the income paid, tries to complete missing tax numbers, and reports the reportable cross-border arrangements it is involved in.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, BWBR0002320, Stb. 1959, 301, consolidated text in force from 2026-10-01

text.en: The general Dutch statute on the levying of state taxes: it holds the rules common to the tax acts, among them the duty to keep records and to give the tax inspector information. It binds every taxpayer and every party required to keep records, which includes each legal body and so each bank. In practice a bank keeps its administration and the data carriers behind it for seven years in a form the inspector can check, answers the inspector's questions about the taxation of its customers, and delivers on its own initiative the data the tax rules designate, with the citizen service number.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet giraal effectenverkeer, BWBR0003109, Stb. 1977, 333, consolidated text in force from 2023-01-01

text.en: The Dutch statute on securities held in book-entry form: clients co-own the collective deposit their intermediary keeps for each class of security. It binds intermediaries, meaning banks and investment firms, and every party in the custody chain of shares. In practice an intermediary lets co-owners exercise their voting rights, answers an issuer's request to identify shareholders without delay, passes company information down the chain and shareholders' instructions up, publishes its charges for these services and records which positions belong to its clients' segregated derivatives assets.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Bankwet 1998, BWBR0009508, Stb. 1998, 200, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-22

text.en: The Dutch statute on De Nederlandsche Bank: it sets the central bank's objectives, tasks, governance and secrecy within the European System of Central Banks. It mostly binds the Bank itself; credit institutions, payment service providers and the undertakings a decree designates meet it in two places. In practice a bank checks every euro banknote it receives for fitness before putting it back into circulation, following the European Central Bank's procedures, hands unfit notes in to De Nederlandsche Bank, and supplies the data the Bank asks for its statistics within the period set.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht 2019, BWBR0041548, Stb. 2018, 409, consolidated text in force from 2026-08-15

text.en: The Dutch statute on who pays for financial supervision: it governs the budgets and accounts of the Authority for the Financial Markets and De Nederlandsche Bank and passes their costs on to the sector. It binds every person under their supervision and everyone for whom they carry out a one-off act. In practice a bank pays the fee set for each one-off act carried out for it and the amount the supervisor charges every year for ongoing supervision, which follows from the supervisor's budget and is divided among categories of supervised persons under a decree.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, BWBR0020586, Stb. 2006, 591, consolidated text in force from 2026-06-25

text.en: The Dutch statute that makes consumer law enforceable by public authorities: it names the Authority for the Financial Markets as the competent authority where a breach concerns a financial service or activity. It binds every trader dealing with consumers. In practice a bank follows the Civil Code's rules for consumer and distance contracts, does not hold a consumer to a voidable general term, uses no unfair commercial practices, tells the authority when an online sales service falls short of the accessibility requirements, and documents any claim that meeting them is too heavy a burden.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Wet financiële betrekkingen buitenland 1994, BWBR0006547, Stb. 1994, 258, consolidated text in force from 2013-01-01

text.en: The Dutch statute on financial relations with other countries: it lets the Minister of Finance restrict capital movements to and from third countries in the cases the EU treaty allows, and it founds the reporting for the balance of payments. The reporting duty binds everyone to whom De Nederlandsche Bank addresses its reporting rules, banks and other financial firms among them. In practice a bank reports the data the Bank's rules ask for to compile the balance of payments, on time, truthfully and without misleading, and lets the Bank verify the figures in its books when asked.
